description.short_caption: Erythema and fissuring in the inguinal region.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows the inguinal region with erythema, fissuring, and mild exudation. The skin appears inflamed with areas of redness and superficial breakdown. A gloved hand is gently retracting the surrounding skin to expose the affected area. No obvious vesicles, pustules, or necrosis are visible.

description.short_caption: Erythematous rash with marked swelling and induration on the chest and upper abdomen.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows the chest and upper abdomen of a patient with a diffuse erythematous rash. The skin appears swollen and indurated, with clear demarcation lines drawn on the skin for monitoring the progression of the lesion. Electrodes are visible, suggesting the patient is being monitored. The findings are consistent with a severe inflammatory or infectious process.
visible_findings: diffuse erythema on the chest and upper abdomen
swelling and induration of the skin
demarcation lines drawn on the skin
monitoring electrodes attached to the chest
